1.consolidated_definition: Planta epifita de hasta 20 cm de altura, con hojas lineares de color verde grisáceo y flores azules o violetas. Bromeliaceae, Tillandsia recurvata.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Epiphytic plant up to 20 cm in height, with linear leaves of grayish-green color and blue or violet flowers. Bromeliaceae, Tillandsia recurvata.
